meta.source: positions.parquet, bullet, split in {train, val} (no test), ply < 20, games 2021-06-18 to 2026-08-12
meta.weights: recency-weighted visit counts: each game contributes 0.5 ** (age_days / 21), age measured from 2026-08-12T02:42:06+00:00 (latest game in the book)
meta.pruning: positions with total weight < 0.02 dropped (blend weight < 7.4%); moves with weight < 0.001 dropped
meta.key: position_key: the first FOUR FEN fields joined by single spaces: piece placement, side to move, castling rights, en passant square. Move counters are dropped. The en passant field follows python-chess's default: it is a square only if a LEGAL en passant capture exists, otherwise '-'. In chess.js, take fen().split(' ').slice(0, 4); if field 3 != '-' and no legal move has flag 'e', set it to '-'.

usage.blend: n = sum of the entry's weights over legal moves; w = n / (n + 0.25); p(move) = w * weight(move) / n + (1 - w) * p_model(move). Out of book: p = p_model.

meta.tuned_on: bullet val, book from train only, model H (23M fine-tune, Elo 1400); see reports/book.md

filter.rule: book moves losing >= 150 cp at Stockfish depth 10 are dropped (product choice: no early blunders); remaining weights kept as is, so book probabilities renormalise over the remaining moves; positions with no moves left are dropped and the model plays there
